{{Short description|University academic administrator (1938–2024)}}
{{For|the Soviet Olympic athlete|Yury Zakharov (athlete)}}
'''Yury Aleksandrovich Zakharov''' ({{Langx|ru|Юрий Александрович Захаров}}; 30 March 1938 – 23 July 2024) was a Soviet and Russian chemist and academic, Rector of [[Kemerovo State University]] from 1978 to 2005.

==Life and career==
Zakharov was born in [[Anzhero-Sudzhensk]].

Zakharov graduated from [[Tomsk State University]] in 1960. Ph.D. in Chemistry,<ref name="zero">[http://mmedia2.kemsu.ru/chairs/chemistry/fb_chem.xsql.en KemSU OnLine | Chairs | Chemical Faculty | Chair of Chemistry of Solids<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050911014051/http://mmedia2.kemsu.ru/chairs/chemistry/fb_chem.xsql.en |date=September 11, 2005 }}</ref> Professor.

He was the author of numerous papers on [[solid-state chemistry]].<ref name="one">E. P. Surovoi, Yu. A. Zakharov, L. N. Bugerko, and L. I. Shurygina, Autocatalysis of the Photolysis of Thallium Azide http://www.maikonline.com/maik/showArticle.do?auid=VAF7LSFZD3</ref><ref name="two">L. T. Bugaenko, Yu. A. Zakharov, S. M. Ryabykh, D. G. Yakubik, RADIATsIONNO-KhIMIChESKAYa STABIL'NOST' IONNYKh I IONNO-MOLEKULYaRNYKh KRISTALLOV [https://web.archive.org/web/20160303231903/http://www.maik.ru/abstract/highen/99/highen5_99p331abs.htm]</ref><ref name="three">B. P. Aduev, É. D. Aluker, G. M. Belokurov, Yu. A. Zakharov and A. G. Krechetov,  Explosive decomposition of heavy-metal azides, https://doi.org/10.1134%2F1.558931</ref> Zakharov was a member of [[Unity (Russian political party)|Unity]] (now [[United Russia]]) from 2000.

In 2005 he quit the post of Rector, when he was indicted on bribery charges.<ref name="four">See an official commentary of Federal Security Service of Russian Federation at {{cite web|url=http://www.fsb.ru/smi/ufsb/2004/040812-3.html |title=КОММЕНТАРИИ ОФИЦИАЛЬНЫХ ПРЕДСТАВИТЕЛЕЙ УФСБ - Федеральная служба безопасности РФ |access-date=December 22, 2007 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041222233826/http://www.fsb.ru/smi/ufsb/2004/040812-3.html |archive-date=December 22, 2004 }} (in Russian)</ref>

Zakharov died on 23 July 2024, at the age of 86.<ref>[https://rossaprimavera.ru/news/b386c8ce В Кемерово умер выдающийся химик Юрий Захаров] {{in lang|ru}}</ref>
